verses.en: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the LORD from the heavens: praise him in the heights.
verses.pt: Aleluia! Louvai ao SENHOR desde os céus; louvai-o nas alturas.
verses.en_web: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!
verses.en_bbe: Give praise to the Lord. Let the Lord be praised from the heavens: give him praise in the skies.

verses.en: Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.
verses.pt: Louvai-o todos os seus anjos; louvai-o todos os seus exércitos.
verses.en_web: Praise him, all his angels! Praise him, all his army!
verses.en_bbe: Give praise to him, all you his angels: give praise to him, all his armies.

verses.en: Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.
verses.pt: Louvai-o, sol e lua; louvai-o, todas as estrelas luminosas.
verses.en_web: Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!
verses.en_bbe: Give praise to him, you sun and moon: give praise to him, all you stars of light.

verses.en: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that be above the heavens.
verses.pt: Louvai-o, céus dos céus, e as águas que estais sobre os céus.
verses.en_web: Praise him, you heavens of heavens, You waters that are above the heavens.
verses.en_bbe: Give praise to him, you highest heavens, and you waters which are over the heavens.

verses.en: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for he commanded, and they were created.
verses.pt: Louvem ao nome do SENHOR; porque pela ordem dele foram criados.
verses.en_web: Let them praise Yahweh’s name, For he commanded, and they were created.
verses.en_bbe: Let them give praise to the name of the Lord: for he gave the order, and they were made.

verses.en: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.
verses.pt: E os firmou para todo o sempre; e deu tal decreto, que não será traspassado.
verses.en_web: He has also established them forever and ever. He has made a decree which will not pass away.
verses.en_bbe: He has put them in their places for ever; he has given them their limits which may not be broken.

verses.en: Praise the LORD from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:
verses.pt: Louvai ao SENHOR vós da terra: os monstros marinhos, e todos os abismos;
verses.en_web: Praise Yahweh from the earth, you great sea creatures, and all depths;
verses.en_bbe: Give praise to the Lord from the earth, you great sea-beasts, and deep places:

verses.en: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapours; stormy wind fulfilling his word:
verses.pt: O fogo e a saraiva, a neve e o vapor; o vento tempestuoso, que executa sua palavra.
verses.en_web: lightning and hail, snow and clouds; stormy wind, fulfilling his word;
verses.en_bbe: Fire and rain of ice, snow and mists; storm-wind, doing his word:

verses.en: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:
verses.pt: Os montes e todos os morros; árvores frutíferas, e todos os cedros.
verses.en_web: mountains and all hills; fruit trees and all cedars;
verses.en_bbe: Mountains and all hills; fruit-trees and all trees of the mountains:

verses.en: Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:
verses.pt: As feras, e todo o gado; répteis, e aves que tem asas.
verses.en_web: wild animals and all livestock; small creatures and flying birds;
verses.en_bbe: Beasts and all cattle; insects and winged birds:

verses.en: Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:
verses.pt: Os reis da terra, e todos os povos; os príncipes, e todos os juízes da terra.
verses.en_web: kings of the earth and all peoples; princes and all judges of the earth;
verses.en_bbe: Kings of the earth, and all peoples; rulers and all judges of the earth:

verses.en: Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:
verses.pt: Os rapazes, e também as moças; os velhos com os jovens.
verses.en_web: both young men and maidens; old men and children:
verses.en_bbe: Young men and virgins; old men and children:

verses.en: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.
verses.pt: Louvem ao nome do SENHOR; pois só o nome dele é exaltado; sua majestade está sobre a terra e o céu.
verses.en_web: let them praise Yahweh’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.
verses.en_bbe: Let them give glory to the name of the Lord: for his name only is to be praised: his kingdom is over the earth and the heaven.

verses.en: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.pt: E ele exaltou o poder de seu povo: o louvor de todos os seus santos, os filhos de Israel, o povo que está perto dele. Aleluia!
verses.en_web: He has lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near to him. Praise Yah!
verses.en_bbe: He has put on high the horn of his people, for the praise of all his saints; even the children of Israel, a people which is near to him. Let the Lord be praised.
